objects.name: sv_b
objects.ddl: CREATE DATABASE `sv_b` /*!40100 DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin */ /*!80016 DEFAULT ENCRYPTION='N' */

objects.name: audit
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `audit` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `customer_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_cust` (`customer_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_audit_customer` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: customers
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `status` enum('a','b','c') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'a',
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'login',
  `phone` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `name` varchar(80) CHARACTER SET latin1 COLLATE latin1_swedish_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `full_name` varchar(200) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (concat(convert(`name` using utf8mb4),_utf8mb4' ',`email`)) VIRTUAL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_email` (`email`),
  KEY `idx_created` (`created_at` DESC),
  KEY `idx_name` (`name`(20)),
  KEY `idx_status` (`status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Customer accounts'

objects.name: item_tags
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `item_tags` (
  `item_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `tag` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`item_id`,`tag`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tag_item` FOREIGN KEY (`item_id`) REFERENCES `items` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

objects.name: items
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `items` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `label` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

objects.name: logs
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `logs` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `at` date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`,`at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
/*!50100 PARTITION BY RANGE (year(`at`))
(PARTITION p2025 VALUES LESS THAN (2026) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION p2026 VALUES LESS THAN (2027) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION p2027 VALUES LESS THAN (2028) ENGINE = InnoDB) */

objects.name: notes
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `notes` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `body` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET latin1 DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` char(10) CHARACTER SET latin1 NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: orders
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `orders` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `customer_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `total` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `note` mediumtext,
  `currency` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
  `hidden_c` int DEFAULT NULL /*!80023 INVISIBLE */,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_customer` (`customer_id`),
  KEY `idx_note_hidden` (`customer_id`) /*!80000 INVISIBLE */,
  KEY `idx_func` (((`total` * 2))),
  FULLTEXT KEY `ft_note` (`note`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_orders_customer` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

objects.name: v_big
objects.ddl: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`%` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `sv_b`.`v_big` AS select `sv_b`.`v_orders`.`id` AS `id`,`sv_b`.`v_orders`.`email` AS `email` from `sv_b`.`v_orders` where (`sv_b`.`v_orders`.`total` > 1000)

objects.name: v_orders
objects.ddl: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`%` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `sv_b`.`v_orders` AS select `o`.`id` AS `id`,`c`.`email` AS `email`,`o`.`total` AS `total` from (`sv_b`.`orders` `o` join `sv_b`.`customers` `c` on((`c`.`id` = `o`.`customer_id`))) where (`o`.`total` > 10)
